explanation: The extra charge is 152 − 80 = PHP 72, or four started 2-kg blocks. Thus total parcel weight is greater than 11 kg and at most 13 kg. Subtracting 1.2 kg gives contents greater than 9.8 kg and at most 11.8 kg. The greatest whole-number weight is 11 kg.

stem: A workshop originally sold 80 tickets: adult tickets at PHP 120 and student tickets at PHP 75. Later, five adult tickets were fully refunded. After these refunds and a PHP 150 processing expense, net receipts were PHP 7,500. How many adult tickets had originally been sold?
explanation: Restore the expense and refunds to recover original sales: 7,500 + 150 + 5 × 120 = PHP 8,250. If all 80 tickets were student tickets, revenue would be PHP 6,000. Each adult ticket adds PHP 45, so (8,250 − 6,000) ÷ 45 = 50 adult tickets were originally sold.
